name: Transgrid Engineering Scholarship at Charles Sturt
summary: Scholarship paid over four years for domestic students starting the Bachelor of Engineering (Honours) at Charles Sturt.
key: MAX $20,000 paid in installments twice yearly.
who: Australian or New Zealand citizen, permanent resident or permanent humanitarian visa holder
Commencing or first-year Bachelor of Engineering (Honours) student
Applied for or holding a Commonwealth Supported Place in the course
